issue.title: Ref Cards
issue.description: Every library reference note opens on a calm, information-dense Ref Card in the Property Card family. The card answers what the reference is, where it came from, where Bryan is with it, and what useful material it holds, and it omits whatever a note lacks. `==` opens a bob-owned Reference editor. bob protects reference sync and identity keys from generic edits. The work ships beside bob-cli-qm and touches it only at named seams.

issue.title: bob props reference roles and the Reference contract
